text:
The response delivers strong sensory imagery and creative metaphors that effectively establish Zephyr's appearance and wandering personality. However, it relies on some familiar fantasy tropes (the mysterious wanderer with a patchwork coat and charm-laden staff) and technically uses two paragraphs when "fewer than two" was strictly requested. The language is evocative but occasionally veers into cliché (e.g., "eyes like the ocean," "shake the very foundations of the earth"), and the character could be more distinctly unique. Overall, it is a vivid, well-written description that meets the core creative goals but falls slightly short on originality and strict constraint adherence.

Rating: [[7]]
